summary.text: Dani O'Halloran is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 20 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
O'Halloran has represented District 20 since 2024 and works as a realtor, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Dani O'Halloran's career experience includes working as a realtor, according to Ballotpedia.
She won District 20 in 2024, defeating Patrick Jude and succeeding Kevin O'Connell.
Jude is her Republican opponent again in the 2026 general election.
